name: Rony Clanton
bio: Rony Clanton was born on 1 November 1946 in Terrace, North Carolina, USA. He is an actor, known for Juice (1992), The Devil's Advocate (1997) and The Royal Tenenbaums (2001).

credits.title: Clashing Through the Snow
credits.overview: Rival publishing editors Ryan Mitchell and Hannah Hendricks are stranded by a holiday snowstorm and forced to share a rental car to New York, where a career-saving deal awaits them both. As roadside mishaps and small-town detours pile up, the holiday spirit begins to melt their fierce rivalry into something unexpected.

credits.title: Rob Peace
credits.overview: An underprivileged, gifted young black man from Newark reaches Yale University, only for shadows and injustices from his past to threaten his future.

credits.title: See You Yesterday
credits.overview: As two teen prodigies try to master the art of time travel, a tragic police shooting sends them on a series of dangerous trips to the past.

credits.title: Hope Springs
credits.overview: After thirty years of marriage, a middle-aged couple attends an intense, week-long counseling session to work on their relationship.

credits.title: Being Flynn
credits.overview: Working in a Boston homeless shelter, Nick Flynn re-encounters his father, a con man and self-proclaimed poet. Sensing trouble in his own life, Nick wrestles with the notion of reaching out yet again to his dad.

credits.title: From Other Worlds
credits.overview: FROM OTHER WORLDS is a sci-fi comedy about a depressed Brooklyn housewife who sleepwalks through her life until she encounters an alien force in her backyard. credits.overview: Katherine Watson is a recent UCLA graduate hired to teach art history at the prestigious all-female Wellesley College, in 1953. credits.title: The Killing Zone
credits.overview: Killing Zone is the story of an affluent Harlem psychiatrist living an unexamined life until his adoptive father- a doctor who plucked him from a Nigerian refugee camp as a child - is gunned down by an eleven-year-old in Brooklyn. credits.title: The Royal Tenenbaums
credits.overview: Royal Tenenbaum and his wife Etheline had three children and then they separated. All three children are extraordinary --- all geniuses. credits.title: The Third Miracle
credits.overview: The Vatican sends a priest to verify some miracles, performed by a woman who has been nominated for sainthood...

credits.title: The Devil's Advocate
credits.overview: Aspiring Florida defense lawyer Kevin Lomax accepts a job at a New York law firm. With the stakes getting higher every case, Kevin quickly learns that his boss has something far more evil planned.

credits.title: Malcolm X
credits.overview: A tribute to the controversial black activist and leader of the struggle for black liberation. He hit bottom during his imprisonment in the '50s, he became a Black Muslim and then a leader in the Nation of Islam. His assassination in 1965 left a legacy of self-determination and racial pride.

credits.title: Juice
credits.overview: Four Harlem friends -- Bishop, Q, Steel and Raheem -- dabble in petty crime, but they decide to go big by knocking off a convenience store. credits.title: The Return of Superfly
credits.overview: Priest returns to New York from Paris to find his friend's murderer. With a couple of new allies, he attempts to bring the killers to justice while trying not to get into criminal activity like he did years ago.

credits.title: Def by Temptation
credits.overview: An evil succubus is preying on libidinous black men in New York, and all that stands in her way is a minister-in-training, an aspiring actor, and a cop that specializes in cases involving the supernatural.

credits.title: The Ambulance
credits.overview: One minute Josh Baker is meeting the woman of his dreams. The next, he's watching her whisked away by a mysterious ambulance that never arrives at the local hospital. Doubted by the police, Josh is forced to carry on a one-man crusade that leads to a discovery more frightening than his worst fears.

credits.title: The Man Who Broke 1,000 Chains
credits.overview: The true story of Robert Elliot Burns, the prisoner who, after being sentenced to a Georgia chain gang, attempted two daring escapes.

credits.title: Rappin'
credits.overview: An ex-con and break-dancer helps save a neighborhood from a greedy developer while trying to win a rap contest.

credits.title: The Cotton Club
credits.overview: Harlem's legendary Cotton Club becomes a hotbed of passion and violence as the lives and loves of entertainers and gangsters collide.

credits.title: Too Scared to Scream
credits.overview: A killer is brutally attacking several tenants that live in a high rise apartment building in New York City.

credits.title: Running Out
credits.overview: A young woman, unable to handle the stress of raising a family, runs out on her husband and young daughter. 12 years later, she returns in hopes of rekindling a bond with them.

credits.title: Fort Apache, the Bronx
credits.overview: From the sight of a police officer this movie depicts the life in New York's infamous South Bronx. credits.title: Night of the Juggler
credits.overview: When a twisted psychotic kidnaps a young girl, mistaking her for the daughter of a wealthy developer, her father, a hardened ex-cop, doggedly hunts them through New York's seamy streets.

credits.title: Judge Horton and the Scottsboro Boys
credits.overview: In 1930s Alabama, nine young black men are accused of raping two white women. The judge in the case, unlike the rest of the town, comes to believe that the boys are innocent and, against all advice from his friends and family, sets them free, which turns the entire community against him.

credits.title: The Education of Sonny Carson
credits.overview: A 1974 film based on the best-selling autobiography of Sonny Carson who joined a gang and committed petty crime before being sent to prison. After his release from prison he changes his life.

credits.title: Claudine
credits.overview: Claudine is a single mother in New York City who endures an exhausting commute to the suburbs where she works as a maid for wealthy families. credits.title: The Cool World
credits.overview: A fifteen-year-old boy wants to buy a gun from an adult racketeer named Priest, in order to become president of the gang to which he belongs, and to return them to active "bopping" (gang fighting) which has declined in Harlem.
